title: 门店月度环比同比与持续下滑
context: 经营主管希望识别连续三个月环比负增长的门店。
requirements: 构造2023—2025完整门店月份轴；2025年逐月返回净销售、环比、同比及连续三月负增长标志；上期零或缺失时比率NULL。
commonError: 先筛2025再计算窗口会丢失去年和上月。
mysqlSql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev,LAG(net,12) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prior_year FROM b), q AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prev>0 AND net<prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END falling FROM p), z AS (SELECT *,SUM(falling) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) fall3 FROM q) SELECT store_id,month_key,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(net-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) mom_pct,ROUND(100.0*(net-prior_year)/NULLIF(prior_year,0),2) yoy_pct,CASE WHEN fall3=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END three_declines FROM z WHERE month_key>='2025-01' ORDER BY store_id,month_key
